therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: inhibition of leukemic stem cell self-renewal and proliferation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with previously untreated acute myeloid leukemia

results.effect_size: Intensive study: HR 1.08 (95% CI: 0.755-1.532); Non-intensive study: HR 1.04 (95% CI: 0.775-1.388)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma trough concentrations achieved: Intensive study 245-414 ng/mL, Non-intensive study 472-565 ng/mL
results.dose_information: glasdegib 100 mg PO daily continuously for up to 2 years

context.comparator: placebo plus standard chemotherapy (intensive: cytarabine + daunorubicin; non-intensive: azacitidine)
